reason: The Preferred first name input has aria-invalid=true and aria-errormessage pointing to a real, visible span (This field is required) that sits in no live region, and the accessibility tree exposes errormessage and invalid on the textbox. The red message is on screen and follows the input in reading order, so only AT that ignores aria-errormessage loses the cue at the moment of the error; that weakens 4.1.2 a little and blocks nobody, so low.
